# Community Composition
## Floral NMDS
```{r}
set.seed(0)
florNMDS_input <- inat_wide[,-1]
flor.mds <- metaMDS(florNMDS_input, trymax = 50)
```

## Arthropod Functional Groups
```{r}
arthropodsNMDS_input <- arthropods_wide[,-1]
arthropods.mds <- metaMDS(arthropodsNMDS_input, trymax = 50)
```
